lines.en: label sportswars15:
scene newlywedgame1
: You know, we sure have a lot of parties for your typical, run-of-the-mill high school class.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，对一个普普通通的高中班来说，我们的派对可真够多的。

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m well fucking aware.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我他妈清楚得很。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame2
: Yeah, but now you get to be even more aware since you’re actually coming to them with me now!
lines.zh: : 是，不过现在你能更清楚了，因为你这次是真的陪我一起来了！

lines.en: : Chika, I come to all of them. I just normally don’t stay for more than ten minutes because these “parties” are pretty much just free buffets as far as I’m concerned.
lines.zh: : Chika，我每次都来。只是我一般待不了十分钟以上，因为对我来说这些“派对”基本就是自助餐。

lines.en: : Well, yeah. Having two girls in the class who are completely loaded and more than willing to have these things catered can sort of do that. But still- I’m glad you’re here.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。班上有两个富得流油的女生，又特别乐意包办这些吃的，确实会这样。不过还是——我很高兴你来了。

lines.en: : Even if I have to leave in like twenty minutes because I have work in the morning and have to feed my sister. You’re staying here though, right?
lines.zh: : 就算我大概二十分钟后就得走，因为我早上要上班，还得给我妹妹做饭。不过你会留下来的，对吧？

lines.en: : After you’re gone? Fuck no. Who else am I gonna talk to?
lines.zh: : 你走了之后？他妈当然不留。不然我还能跟谁说话？

lines.en: : Rin and Futaba maybe? You guys did share a near-death experience together earlier today. And that normally creates some sort of trauma bond, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : Rin 和 Futaba 怎么样？你们今天早些时候刚一起经历过生死关头。那种事通常会产生某种创伤羁绊吧？

lines.en: : Fuck if I know. And fuck if I care. I’m just here to capitalize on the rich girls’ food and then fuck off back to the old apartment where I can go to sleep without anyone attempting to contact me.
lines.zh: : 我他妈哪知道。我他妈也不在乎。我来这儿就是为了占富婆们的便宜吃一顿，然后滚回那间老公寓，好让我能睡着而没人来找我。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame3
: Well, don’t go capitalizing too hard. We’ve got plenty of mouths to feed and it’s not like Touka’s here to replenish our stores anymore, what with Yasu’s...thing and all.
lines.zh: : 嗯，别占得太狠。我们这儿有的是嘴要喂，而且 Yasu 出了那档子……事之后，Touka 也不在这儿补货了。

lines.en: : Fuck even was that? Looked away for five seconds and turned around to see her on the ground. Which, considering who we’re talkin’ about, wasn’t that weird. But people sure seemed to think it was.
lines.zh: : 那到底是他妈怎么回事？就移开视线五秒钟，一回头就看见她躺在地上。考虑到我们说的是谁，这也不算太奇怪。可大家看起来确实觉得挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : Touka said it was just a migraine. But I guess it could also be more weird God stuff. You never really know when it comes to Yasu.
lines.zh: : Touka 说只是偏头痛。不过我猜也可能又是怪力乱神那一套。碰上 Yasu 的事，你永远说不准。

lines.en: : Either way, I imagine she’s just going to take Yasu back home once they’re out of the infirmary.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我猜等她们从医务室出来，她就会把 Yasu 带回家。

lines.en: : And the same probably goes for Miss Watabe as I can’t imagine her wanting a bigger part in the chaos that is our next contest.
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师大概也一样，我想象不出她会想在下一场比赛的混乱里掺和得更深。

lines.en: : We ain’t even got a clue what the next contest is yet, though. Right? All we’ve got is the fuckin’ name.
lines.zh: : 可我们连下一场比赛是什么都还不知道啊。对吧？我们手上只有那个该死的名字。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I think that’s enough to start piecing things together. And, any second now, Imani’s probably just going to-
lines.zh: : 是啊，但我觉得光是这就够拼出个大概了。而且，随时——Imani 大概马上就要——

lines.en: : Okay! Listen up!
lines.zh: : 好了！听好了！

lines.en: : See? What did I just say?
lines.zh: : 瞧？我刚说什么来着？

lines.en: scene newlywedgame4
: We’ve got this venue for a grand total of four hours before all of us get kicked out and the strippers who usually work here get invited back in!
lines.zh: : 这个场地我们总共只有四个小时，之后我们全得被赶出去，平时在这儿上班的脱衣舞娘就会被请回来！

lines.en: : Why are we having our last two contests in a strip club to begin with?
lines.zh: : 我们一开始为什么要在脱衣舞俱乐部里办最后两场比赛？

lines.en: : Because that’s all I could find, style-thief! Sakaki-bar-a’s gotten too popular lately to host the Dorm Wars. So unless Sana wants to revitalize this place next, this is all we’ve got for the near future.
lines.zh: : 因为我只找得到这个，抄袭风格的小偷！Sakaki-bar-a 最近太火了，办不了宿舍战争。所以除非 Sana 想接下来把这里盘活，否则近期我们就只有这儿了。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if...I have the experience needed to...revitalize a place like this...
lines.zh: : 我不确定……我有没有那种经验……能盘活这种地方……

lines.en: : And...I’m also not sure if I had anything to do with the bar being fixed in the first place.
lines.zh: : 而且……我也不确定当初那间酒吧修好跟我有没有关系。

lines.en: : Then it looks like we’ve got a new secret base! Complete with poles and everything! But please, don’t be afraid to strip away minor details like that as they’ll only complicate what little time we have left!
lines.zh: : 那看来我们有新秘密基地了！钢管什么的应有尽有！不过呢，别怕把这类细枝末节剥掉，它们只会让我们本就所剩无几的时间变得更复杂！

lines.en: : Does our next contest involve the shedding of our robes?
lines.zh: : 我们下一场比赛要脱袍子吗？

lines.en: : No, I just saw an opportunity to make a pun and jumped on it. The ninth contest of this year’s Dorm Wars will be a lot more simple and likely won’t involve the removal of any clothing.
lines.zh: : 不，我只是逮到一个玩双关的机会就顺手用了。今年宿舍战争的第九场比赛会简单得多，而且大概不会涉及脱任何衣服。

lines.en: : Likely?
lines.zh: : 大概？

lines.en: scene newlywedgame5
: You’re all young and shit, so you’re probably not familiar with the Newlywed Game. But basically, the way it works is that couples face off to see who knows their partner better.
lines.zh: : 你们都还小什么的，大概没听说过《新婚游戏》。简单来说，就是情侣们同台比拼，看谁更了解自己的伴侣。

lines.en: : And the justification I have thought up to permit the inclusion of this game in the Dorm Wars, specifically the sports day variant, is the fact that it requires some form of teamwork. However, there is a twist.
lines.zh: : 而我想出来的、能把这个游戏塞进宿舍战争（尤其是运动会版本）的理由是，它确实需要某种团队合作。不过，有个转折。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame6
: You’re all really cliquey and shit. So, if I were to send Rin and Futaba up there against Uta and Io, no new bonds would be formed and no progress would be made.
lines.zh: : 你们都太爱抱团了什么的。所以，要是我让 Rin 和 Futaba 上去对上 Uta 和 Io，就不会形成任何新的牵绊，也不会有任何进展。

lines.en: : Today, despite all of the chaos and turmoil, has ultimately been centered around bringing all of you closer together. And I feel like we’ve accomplished that in a number of ways.
lines.zh: : 今天，尽管一片混乱与骚动，归根结底都是为了把你们所有人拉得更近。而我觉得我们在很多方面已经做到了。

lines.en: : But the true test comes now- as I’ll be drawing two names at random for each floor and testing their knowledge about one another.
lines.zh: : 但真正的考验现在才到——我会为每层随机抽出两个名字，考一考她们对彼此的了解。

lines.en: : How close have you studied your classmates? How much of an impression have they left on you? But, most importantly...how will you fare as newlyweds?!
lines.zh: : 你有多仔细地观察过你的同学？她们给你留下了多少印象？但最重要的是……作为新婚夫妻，你们会表现如何？！

lines.en: scene newlywedgame7
: Fun, right?!
lines.zh: : 有意思吧？！

lines.en: : I apologize, but I am already married.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，但我已经结婚了。

lines.en: : I also apologize, but I will be in the future.
lines.zh: : 我也道歉，不过我将来会结婚的。

lines.en: : Hopefully, all of us will be in the future.
lines.zh: : 希望我们将来都会。

lines.en: : I could get married whenever I want and no one can do anything about it.
lines.zh: : 我想什么时候结婚就什么时候结，谁也管不着。

lines.en: : Woo! Great job being independent, Makoto!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！Makoto，独立自主干得漂亮！

lines.en: : She just means she’s holding a marriage license hostage.
lines.zh: : 她的意思是，她把一张结婚证当人质扣着呢。

lines.en: : Since when do you know about that?
lines.zh: : 你从什么时候知道这事的？

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter. I will find it and destroy it. Mark my words.
lines.zh: : 这不重要。我会找到它然后毁掉。记住我的话。

lines.en: : Well, I’m kind of screwed if I have to go up there and guess shit about anyone other than you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，要是我得上台去猜除了你以外任何人的事，我就完蛋了。

lines.en: : That fate could have been easily avoided had you only read my book, Otoha. I quite accurately chronicled the inner-workings of all the girls in our class. Sometimes, even the sexual ones.
lines.zh: : 只要你读过我的书，这种命运本来是可以轻松避免的，Otoha。我把班上所有女生的内在运作都相当准确地记录了下来。有时候，甚至包括性方面的。

lines.en: : Sometimes?
lines.zh: : 有时候？

lines.en: : Why, yes. Not all of them have experience yet, after all. At least not the type that would directly relate to the protagonist of the story.
lines.zh: : 是啊，毕竟不是每个人都有经验。至少不是那种和故事主人公直接相关的经验。

lines.en: : And my audience tends to care more about that than information gained through alternate sources.
lines.zh: : 而且我的读者往往更在意那个，胜过从其他渠道得来的信息。

lines.en: : For example, simply spilling out traumatic events from a character’s past would serve no purpose other than to-
lines.zh: : 比如说，单纯把一个角色过去的创伤事件倒出来，除了——之外没有任何意义。

lines.en: : Hey, fun idea. How about you don’t give me a lesson on literature inside of a strip club?
lines.zh: : 嘿，好主意。你要不要在脱衣舞俱乐部里别给我上文学课？

lines.en: scene newlywedgame8
: Would you prefer I strip for you instead?
lines.zh: : 那你是更想让我脱给你看？

lines.en: : No. But I would like to know why you’re wearing a suit. And I wouldn’t mind if you replaced it with something more fitting for this event.
lines.zh: : 不。但我想知道你为什么穿西装。而且你要是能换一身更适合这个场合的衣服，我也不介意。

lines.en: : I have another event to attend after this one — the type one should dress up for. Does that satisfy your curiosity?
lines.zh: : 这场之后我还有一场活动要参加——那种需要盛装出席的。这满足你的好奇心了吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Well, then. Hopefully this next contest will.
lines.zh: : 那么好吧。希望下一场比赛能满足。

lines.en: : Aaaaaaand the first girl to be chosen for the Newly-Newlywed Game is Nodoka Nagasawa, because of course it is.
lines.zh: : 那——第一位被选中参加新新婚游戏的女生是 Nodoka Nagasawa，果然是她。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame9

: Oh, heck yeah! Nodoka’s accurately guessed the color of my underwear every day for the last three months! She knows everything even when nobody tells her! Which is creepy! But in this context, great!
lines.zh: : 哦，太好了！Nodoka 过去三个月每天都精准猜中我内裤的颜色！没人告诉她她也什么都知道！这很诡异！但在这个场合，很棒！

lines.en: : What can I say? I have super powers.
lines.zh: : 我能说什么呢？我有超能力。

lines.en: : You realize you can probably press charges if you have that many instances of sexual harassment from one person, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道吧，一个人对你有这么多性骚扰的记录，你大概可以起诉她了，对吧？

lines.en: scene newlywedgame10
: Yes, but I don’t want to have to move again.
lines.zh: : 知道，但我不想再搬家了。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Aaaaand the second girl chosen for this contest is Io Ichimonji! Come on down, you two!
lines.zh: : 那——第二位被选中参加这场比赛的女生是 Io Ichimonji！你们俩上来吧！

lines.en: scene newlywedgame11
: Oh?
: Me?! Why me?! I already participated today! I should be exempt from having to do that again!
lines.zh: : 我？！为什么是我？！我今天已经参加过了！我应该被豁免，不用再来一次才对！

lines.en: : She chose the names at random, Io. It’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 她是随机抽名字的，Io。没问题的。

lines.en: : No it won’t! I don’t know shit about Nodoka! And it’s not like I want to go up there and guess!
lines.zh: : 才不会有问题！我对 Nodoka 一无所知！而且我根本不想上台去猜！

lines.en: scene newlywedgame12

: Then you’re in luck! Because we only have time for one round from each team if we want to hang out and mingle and stuff. Meaning only one of you will guess answers while the other simply provides them.
lines.zh: : 那你走运了！因为如果我们还想留时间给大家交际什么的，每队就只来得及进行一轮。也就是说，你们其中一个负责猜答案，另一个只要提供答案就行。

lines.en: : See! I told you it’d be fine. You can literally just stand there and write about all of the stuff you like and dislike on a little tablet. It’s the perfect job for you.
lines.zh: : 瞧！我说了没问题的。你就站在那儿，在小板子上写下你喜欢和不喜欢的东西就行。这活儿再适合你不过了。

lines.en: : Uhh, Uta? I think my “perfect job” involves a little less “standing on a stage in front of a crowd of people.”
lines.zh: : 呃，Uta？我觉得我的“完美工作”应该少一点“站在一群人面前的舞台上”的成分。

lines.en: : Just pretend we’re all in our underwear! Or be like Nodoka and just inherently understand all of our underwear!
lines.zh: : 就假装我们都只穿着内裤好了！或者学 Nodoka，天生就懂我们所有人的内裤！

lines.en: : I’m gonna get called for this shit, ain’t I?
lines.zh: : 我早晚要因为这破事被点名，是吧？

lines.en: : Nah. With our luck, it’ll probably be Maya and we’ll automatically lose the contest since she still isn’t here.
lines.zh: : 不会。以我们的运气，大概会抽到 Maya，反正她还没来，那这场比赛我们就自动输了。

lines.en: : The first girl competing for the first floor is Yumi Yamaguchi.
lines.zh: : 一层第一位参赛的女生是 Yumi Yamaguchi。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame13
: Or I’m completely wrong.
lines.zh: : 或者我完全猜错了。

lines.en: : God fucking damn it.
lines.zh: : 我操他妈的。

lines.en: : You got this, Yumi!
lines.zh: : 你能行的，Yumi！

lines.en: : Yeah! Just think of all the reasons you avoid us and those will probably be the correct answers!
lines.zh: : 对啊！想想你躲着我们的所有理由，那些大概就是正确答案！

lines.en: : On the bright side, you won’t be everyone’s most-hated person up there. All three girls have been pretty divisive so far. And, if it’s any consolation, you’re my favorite out of all of them.
lines.zh: : 往好处想，你在台上不会是大家最讨厌的那个人。目前这三个女生都挺有争议的。而且，如果这能给你点安慰的话——她们三个里我最喜欢你。

lines.en: : It’s not.
lines.zh: : 并不。

lines.en: : Aaaaaaand the last girl chosen to compete is Makoto Miyamura!
lines.zh: : 那——最后一位被选中参赛的女生是 Makoto Miyamura！

lines.en: scene newlywedgame14
: Fantastic.
lines.zh: : 好极了。

lines.en: : Yumi and me?
lines.zh: : Yumi 和我？

lines.en: : How the heck is this gonna go? Ain’t ever seen you two talk if it ain’t about school stuff or Yumi gettin’ in trouble.
lines.zh: : 这可怎么搞？我从来没见过你们俩说话，除非是聊学校的事或者 Yumi 又惹麻烦了。

lines.en: : That’s a good question. Though, I suppose if Miss Imai’s goal really is to force some of us closer together, this is as adequate a pairing as any.
lines.zh: : 问得好。不过，如果 Imai 老师的目标真是要逼我们中的一些人拉近距离，这搭配也算够格了。

lines.en: : Adequate my ass, Prez. Only thing I know about you is that you’ve got a hard-on for givin’ me homework.
lines.zh: : 够格个屁，会长。我对你唯一的了解就是你就爱给我布置作业。

lines.en: : Makoto’s like that with everybody. It ain’t just a Yumi thing.
lines.zh: : Makoto 对谁都这样。又不是只针对 Yumi。

lines.en: : I barely even do that anymore. And besides, it’s not like I know anything about you either. You rarely speak to anyone at all apart from Chika.
lines.zh: : 我现在都基本不做了。再说了，我也不了解你啊。除了 Chika 你几乎不跟任何人说话。

lines.en: scene black
: Well, that changes now! Because both teams have a total of five minutes to get to know one another and designate positions!
lines.zh: : 嗯，那现在就要改了！因为两队总共有五分钟的时间来彼此了解、并确定分工！

lines.en: : I would like the bottom bunk. Climbing down from the top isn’t good for my knees.
lines.zh: : 我想要下铺。从上铺爬下来对膝盖不好。

lines.en: : And I would like to know where I dropped my cyanide capsule. I could have sworn I had one just a second ago.
lines.zh: : 而我想知道我把氰化物胶囊掉哪儿了。我发誓一秒前还在手上呢。

lines.en: : Come on, Yumi. Let’s see how much we can cram into just a few minutes worth of studying time.
lines.zh: : 来吧，Yumi。看看我们能在区区几分钟的学习时间里塞进多少东西。

lines.en: : This ain’t the fuckin’ time for learning shit, you dumb-
lines.zh: : 这他妈可不是学东西的时候，你这个蠢——

lines.en: : Studying things about each other. Context clues, Yumi. Context clues.
lines.zh: : 是了解彼此的事。上下文线索，Yumi。上下文线索。

lines.en: : Hah...we’re fucked, aren’t we?
lines.zh: : 哈……我们完蛋了，是吧？

lines.en: Approximately ten minutes later...
lines.zh: 大约十分钟之后……

lines.en: scene newlywedgame15
: Okay! Now that our first batch of contestants has taken the stage, let’s get this show on the road!
lines.zh: : 好了！既然我们第一批选手已经上台，那就开始吧！

lines.en: : Yumi — you’ve been the one chosen from your team to answer questions about Makoto. But just how well can you do that, I wonder?
lines.zh: : Yumi——你是你们队里被选出来回答关于 Makoto 问题的人。不过我很好奇，你能答得多好？

lines.en: : I can't.
lines.zh: : 我不能。

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want to swap positions? I feel like my memory might be a bit better than-
lines.zh: : 你确定不想换一下分工吗？我觉得我的记性可能比——

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m fuckin’ sure. You really think I’m gonna go up there and air out my interests after I’ve worked so hard to keep that shit a secret? Nah. Ain’t happenin’. Hit me with the first question, Teach.
lines.zh: : 对，我他妈确定。你真以为我会上台把自己的喜好抖出来？我费了多大劲才把那玩意儿藏住。不。不可能。问第一个问题吧，老师。

lines.en: : Question one — what is Makoto’s favorite color?
lines.zh: : 第一问——Makoto 最喜欢的颜色是什么？

lines.en: scene newlywedgame16
: Uhh...
: Am I allowed to phone a friend?
lines.zh: : 我可以打电话求助吗？

lines.en: : Do you even have any?
lines.zh: : 你有朋友吗？

lines.en: : Chika — what’s the Prez’s favorite color?
lines.zh: : Chika——会长最喜欢什么颜色？

lines.en: : I don’t think I’m allowed to answer these questions for you, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我不能替你回答这些问题，Yumi。

lines.en: : This was literally the first thing I told you when I pulled you aside. It’s such a baseline question that I figured it would have to come up eventually.
lines.zh: : 我把你拉到一边的时候，这可是我告诉你的第一件事。这是最基础的问题，我就觉得迟早会问到。

lines.en: : Yeah, I wasn’t payin’ attention.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我当时没在听。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame17
: Hah...
: I don’t know. Let’s just go with blue.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。就选蓝色吧。

lines.en: : No, it’s-
lines.zh: : 不对，是——

lines.en: scene newlywedgame18
: Oh.
scene newlywedgame19
: You somehow got it right.
lines.zh: : 你居然蒙对了。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame20
: Nodoka! In order to make things fair since I’m not convinced you aren’t just a living repository for all information ever, I’ve decided to make your questions a bit harder!
lines.zh: : Nodoka！为了公平起见——我可没排除你就是个活体信息库的可能性——我决定把你的问题出难一点！

lines.en: : Please do not handle me too roughly, madam speaker. I break easily.
lines.zh: : 请别对我太粗暴，主持人女士。我很容易碎。

lines.en: : Can you maybe cut back on the eye contact a little? Thanks.
lines.zh: : 你能不能少盯着我一点？谢了。

lines.en: : Nodoka, what is Io’s favorite insect in the Saharan desert?
lines.zh: : Nodoka，Io 在撒哈拉沙漠里最喜欢的昆虫是什么？

lines.en: : Is that a fair question? Even I don’t know the answer to that and I live with both Io and a bug.
lines.zh: : 这问题公平吗？连我都不知道答案，而我可是和 Io 还有一只虫子住在一起的人。

lines.en: : It’s Nodoka. I’m sure she knows.
lines.zh: : 那可是 Nodoka。我肯定她知道。

lines.en: : My gut instinct is to say it’s the Saharan Silver Ant or cataglyphis bombycina as it’s a somewhat reclusive bug that only ventures outside of its burrow for about ten minutes per day, so...
lines.zh: : 我的直觉告诉我，是撒哈拉银蚁，也就是 cataglyphis bombycina，因为它算是比较孤僻的虫子，每天只出洞大约十分钟，所以……

lines.en: : Saharan silver ant. Final answer.
lines.zh: : 撒哈拉银蚁。最终答案。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame21
: How the fuck did you know that?
lines.zh: : 你他妈怎么知道的？

lines.en: : Lucky guess, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 大概猜得巧吧。

lines.en: : Welp! As great as it would be for Nodoka to be wrong about something, the score is now one to one!
lines.zh: : 好吧！虽然 Nodoka 能答错一次会很爽，但现在比分是一比一！

lines.en: scene newlywedgame22
: Yumi!
lines.zh: : Yumi！

lines.en: : Yo.
: What is Makoto’s favorite movie of all time?
lines.zh: : Makoto 有史以来最喜欢的电影是什么？

lines.en: : I told you this too. Another very simple question.
lines.zh: : 这个我也告诉你了。又是个很简单的问题。

lines.en: : Fuck if I know. Die Hard, maybe?
lines.zh: : 我他妈哪知道。《虎胆龙威》，大概？

lines.en: scene newlywedgame23
: Aaaaand our luck has run out.
lines.zh: : 那——我们的运气到头了。

lines.en: : Hey, at least I got the death part right. Ain’t my fault you’d rather watch some poets die than Bruce Willis bein’ a fuckin’ badass.
lines.zh: : 嘿，至少我猜对了“死”那部分。你喜欢看一群诗人死掉，胜过看 Bruce Willis 耍他妈的帅，这可不是我的错。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame24
: Nodoka! What is Io’s favorite volatile organic compound?
lines.zh: : Nodoka！Io 最喜欢的挥发性有机化合物是什么？

lines.en: : I would assume it’s ethanol as I believe she spends a fair amount of time woodworking and it’s the most interesting-sounding compound used in wood polish.
lines.zh: : 我猜是乙醇，因为我觉得她花不少时间做木工，而它是木器上光剂里听起来最有趣的化合物。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame25
: You’re creepy.
lines.zh: : 你真瘆人。

lines.en: : In a good way or a bad way?
lines.zh: : 是好的那种还是坏的那种？

lines.en: : In a way that makes me not want to play this game anymore. Or even be in the same room with you if you can just read my thoughts like that.
lines.zh: : 是那种让我再也不想玩这个游戏的程度。甚至如果你能这样读出我的想法，我连和你待在同一个房间里都不想。

lines.en: : I’m no “mind-reader.” I’m simply more perceptive than most and have a fair bit of expertise when it comes to interpreting the actions of others.
lines.zh: : 我可不是什么“读心师”。我只是比大多数人观察力更强，而且在解读他人行为方面还算专业。

lines.en: : And I suppose I’m a tad bit lucky as well as there is always the possibility that I’ll get one of these questions wrong.
lines.zh: : 而且我想我也有那么点运气，毕竟我总有可能会答错其中一道题。

lines.en: : All I’m really doing is picking the most likely answer based on the information I do have.
lines.zh: : 我真正在做的，只是根据我掌握的信息挑出最可能的答案。

lines.en: : Translation: I am very creepy. Thank you for noticing.
lines.zh: : 翻译一下：我非常瘆人。谢谢你的注意。

lines.en: : You all give me far too much credit for just being me.
lines.zh: : 你们对我只是做自己这件事，给了太多过分的评价。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame26
: Yumi! What is Makoto’s favorite pizza topping?
lines.zh: : Yumi！Makoto 最喜欢的披萨配料是什么？

lines.en: : It’s pepperoni. Say pepperoni.
lines.zh: : 是意大利辣香肠。说意大利辣香肠。

lines.en: : Her favorite pizza topping is knowledge.
lines.zh: : 她最喜欢的披萨配料是知识。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame27
: Incorrect!
lines.zh: : 错误！

lines.en: : Oh, would you look at that?
lines.zh: : 哦，你瞧瞧？

lines.en: : You’re not even trying! I literally handed you the answer on a silver platter that time! Also, knowledge isn’t even tangible! You can’t put it on a pizza!
lines.zh: : 你根本就没在努力！那一次我可是把答案直接端到你面前了！再说了，知识又不是实体！你不能把它放在披萨上！

lines.en: : Well, I guess now I know that for the future.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想这下我知道以后该怎么做了。

lines.en: : Why are you throwing the competition?! All of these questions have been incredibly easy even if you just learned them!
lines.zh: : 你为什么要放水？！所有这些问题都简单得要命，哪怕你是刚记住的也一样！

lines.en: : Yeah. But if I get more than one right, people will start to think we’re friends. And now that Noriko’s started to claim that, shit’s getting way too busy for me.
lines.zh: : 是啊。可我要是答对超过一道，别人就要开始觉得我们是朋友了。现在 Noriko 都开始这么说了，我这破事已经够多了。

lines.en: : Plus, we’re up against someone who’s guessin’ fuckin’ bugs and chemicals and shit correctly. We ain’t winning this one no matter how badly we want to.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我们的对手连他妈的虫子、化学品什么的都能猜对。不管我们多想赢，这场都赢不了。

lines.en: : You wouldn’t know that for sure unless you tried! But we’re so far behind now that we’ll probably never find out, will we?!
lines.zh: : 你不试怎么知道！可我们落后太多了，大概永远也没机会知道了，是吧？！

lines.en: : Darn. How will life ever go on after today?
lines.zh: : 哎呀。今天之后的日子可怎么过啊？

lines.en: scene black
: AAAAAAAAAAH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : Nodoka! You’re up next!
lines.zh: : Nodoka！轮到你了！

lines.en: Ten minutes and ten questions later...
lines.zh: 十分钟、十道题之后……

lines.en: scene newlywedgame28
: Well, as expected, the score is now twelve to one in favor of the second floor.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不出所料，比分现在是十二比一，二层领先。

lines.en: : But, even though the outcome of this last question will not change anything even if Nodoka gets it wrong, I’m going to read it anyway because I still want to stump her.
lines.zh: : 不过，尽管最后一题的结果不会改变什么，就算 Nodoka 答错也一样，我还是要把题念出来，因为我还是想难住她。

lines.en: : I’ve been stumped several times, Miss Imai. I’m just very lucky.
lines.zh: : 我被难住过好几次呢，Imai 老师。我只是运气好。

lines.en: : Yeah. Well, let’s see how lucky you are after this one.
lines.zh: : 是吗。那就看看这一题之后你运气还怎么样。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame29
: What is Io’s most precious memory?
lines.zh: : Io 最珍贵的回忆是什么？

lines.en: scene newlywedgame30
: Her most precious memory?...
lines.zh: : 她最珍贵的回忆？……

lines.en: : I have accepted that I can not stump you with anything involving actual knowledge, so the only way I can is by smackin’ you upside the head with emotion, feelings, and life experience!
lines.zh: : 我已经认了，凡是涉及真正知识的东西都难不住你，所以我唯一的办法就是拿情绪、感情和人生经验狠狠敲你的头！

lines.en: : So! Go ahead, Nodoka! Guess the specific memory this girl you’ve never had a real conversation with holds closest to her heart!
lines.zh: : 那么！来吧，Nodoka！猜猜看，这个你从来没真正聊过的女孩，心里最珍视的到底是哪一段具体的回忆！

lines.en: scene newlywedgame31
: You know you can just guess something random at this point, right? We’ve already won. There’s no need to pad the score. That’s like stealing a base when your team’s up 10-0. It’s unnecessary.
lines.zh: : 你知道你现在随便猜一个也行吧？我们已经赢了。没必要再刷分了。那就像你球队已经 10 比 0 领先还去偷垒。完全没必要。

lines.en: : I suppose you’re right- but that does nothing for my curiosity. This is the first question that has actually interested me- and also the only one I have not immediately had an answer for.
lines.zh: : 我想你是对的——但这满足不了我的好奇心。这是第一道真正让我感兴趣的题——也是唯一一道我没有立刻想到答案的题。

lines.en: : It’s pepperoni. Just say pepperoni.
lines.zh: : 是意大利辣香肠。就说意大利辣香肠。

lines.en: : No, I don’t think I’ll do that.
lines.zh: : 不，我不打算那么做。

lines.en: : In fact...I’m not sure there is a correct answer to this question. At least not in the sense that would earn me another point.
lines.zh: : 事实上……我不确定这道题有正确答案。至少不是那种能让我再拿一分的意义上的正确答案。

lines.en: : And I think that, even if I were to guess correctly, the answer wouldn’t be the same as what you’ve written down as your instinctive response to a request to reveal such information would be to close yourself off.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得，就算我猜对了，答案也不会和你写下来的相同——因为被要求透露这种信息时，你的本能反应就是把自己封闭起来。

lines.en: : Just fucking say pepperoni. Say anything.
lines.zh: : 他妈的就说意大利辣香肠。随便说点什么。

lines.en: : I can’t...because any answer I give would be met with a buzzer.
lines.zh: : 我不能……因为不管我给出什么答案，都会被判错。

lines.en: : All but one, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少除了一个答案之外都是。

lines.en: : I think you left the tablet blank.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你把板子留空了。

lines.en: : Io! Please reveal your answer!
lines.zh: : Io！请亮出你的答案！

lines.en: scene newlywedgame32
: Heh.
: Fuck!
: You can read me as much as you want, Nodoka. It’s not impressive.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，你想怎么解读我都行。这没什么了不起的。

lines.en: : Any therapist could have arrived at that same answer after meeting with me once or twice.
lines.zh: : 随便哪个心理医生，跟我见过一两次面也能得出同样的答案。

lines.en: : I would hope so. It’d be rather poor form for a girl my age to be more effective at reading people than trained professionals. I’m just a normal teenager.
lines.zh: : 我也希望如此。要是我这个年纪的女孩比受过训练的专业人士还擅长读人，那可太不成体统了。我只是个普通的少女。

lines.en: : You’re far from normal and you know that.
lines.zh: : 你一点都不普通，你自己清楚。

lines.en: : You can sit there...and you can smile...and you can pretend you’re not hot shit...But we all know that’s not how you really feel on the inside.
lines.zh: : 你可以坐在那儿……你可以微笑……你可以装作自己不是什么了不起的人物……可我们都知道，你心里不是这么想的。

lines.en: : You think you’re better than us. And, in some ways, you are. I mean, you beat me in everything for sure. But that’s even less impressive than a ten-minute psych-eval. Because I am nothing and that’s obvious.
lines.zh: : 你觉得自己比我们强。而在某些方面，你确实是。我的意思是，你什么都比我强，这点毫无疑问。可那甚至还不如一次十分钟的心理评估来得厉害。因为我什么都不是，这一点明摆着。

lines.en: : I have no “cherished memories.” I’m not just keeping them to myself. That’s why the tablet was blank.
lines.zh: : 我没有什么“珍贵的回忆”。我不是故意藏着不说。所以板子才是空的。

lines.en: : Is there a problem, Io? You seem rather offended that someone here actually seems to understand you on some level.
lines.zh: : 有什么问题吗，Io？这里有人似乎在某种程度上真的理解你，你看起来挺生气的。

lines.en: : Knowing and understanding are two different things. So you can know as much as you want. But you’ll never really get it, Nodoka. You’ll never understand me the way you’re pretending to right now.
lines.zh: : 知道和理解是两回事。所以你想知道多少就知道了多少吧。可你永远也不会真的懂，Nodoka。你永远也不会像你现在假装的这样理解我。

lines.en: : Would you perhaps like to continue this conversation in private so I may further inquire as to why you think that way about me?
lines.zh: : 你要不要私下继续聊，好让我进一步了解你为什么会这样看我？

lines.en: : I’m a very friendly girl, Io. I’d quite enjoy some one-on-one time with you if you’ll have me.
lines.zh: : 我是个很友善的女孩，Io。如果你愿意，我会很享受和你单独相处的时光。

lines.en: : I’m not interested in making friends. And I’m definitely not interested in “one-on-one” time with you.
lines.zh: : 我对交朋友没兴趣。而且我绝对没兴趣和你“单独相处”。

lines.en: : Is that because it’s me specifically? Or would you extend that same rotting olive branch to all of us who were blessed to be born with slits between our legs?
lines.zh: : 是因为我这个人吗？还是说，你会把那根腐烂的橄榄枝同样递给我们这些有幸生来双腿之间带条缝的人？

lines.en: : Aight. Time to wrap things up. That’s enough out of you two.
lines.zh: : 好了。该收场了。你们俩说够了。

lines.en: : Why even ask? It’s not like there’s anything left for you to learn since you apparently already know it all.
lines.zh: : 何必还问？你显然什么都已经知道了，还有什么可学的。

lines.en: : I suppose I don’t need to.
lines.zh: : 我想是不必了。

lines.en: : It’s rather evident based on your actions and tendencies that much of this animosity stems from the fact that you’ve been sexually abused in some way. I’m just trying to figure out if it was family or a friend.
lines.zh: : 从你的行为和倾向来看很明显，你这份敌意多半源于你曾遭受过某种形式的性侵。我只是想搞清楚，是家人还是朋友干的。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame33
: Mother, perhaps? If you were young enough, I can see how that would permanently skew your outlook concerning women as a whole. And if you’re that opposed to simply being alone with me-
lines.zh: : 也许是母亲？如果你当时年纪够小，我就能理解这会如何永久地扭曲你对女性的整体看法。而如果你如此抗拒单单和我独处——

lines.en: scene newlywedgame34
: Oh. She’s gone.
lines.zh: : 哦。她走了。

lines.en: : Io! Wait!
lines.zh: : Io！等等！

lines.en: scene black
scene newlywedgame35
: Well, that’s a rather unique expression for you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这表情对你来说可真够特别的。

lines.en: : I take it you are going to hit me now?
lines.zh: : 看来你是要打我了？

lines.en: : Why did you do that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要那么做？

lines.en: : I intended to ask in private. Unfortunately, it did not seem as if that would ever be an option.
lines.zh: : 我本来打算私下问的。可惜，看起来那永远都不会是个选项。

lines.en: : Are you disappointed in me, Uta-chan?
lines.zh: : 你对我失望了吗，Uta-chan？

lines.en: : I don’t think I’ve ever been this disgusted in my life. And, since you probably already know about me too, that’s saying a lot.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子大概从来没有这么恶心过。而且，既然你大概也已经知道了我的事，这可说明了很多。

lines.en: : Perhaps you should try looking at this from my perspective? I-
lines.zh: : 也许你该试着从我的角度看？我——

lines.en: scene newlywedgame36
: Perhaps you should leave my friend alone!
lines.zh: : 也许你该离我朋友远点！

lines.en: scene newlywedgame37
: Well, that wasn’t looking at this from my perspective at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这可完全没从我的角度看。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame38
: Oh. Hello, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 哦。你好，Otoha。

lines.en: : Apologies. I appear to have caused a bit of a disturbance again.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。看来我又引起了一点骚动。

lines.en: scene newlywedgame39
: Uta didn’t say it, so I will.
lines.zh: : Uta 没说，所以我来说。

lines.en: : I’m very disappointed in you, Nodoka. You crossed the line and you know it.
lines.zh: : 我对你非常失望，Nodoka。你越界了，你自己清楚。

lines.en: : Go home.
lines.zh: : 回家去。

lines.en: : I was simply giving her the opportunity to-
lines.zh: : 我只是给她一个机会去——

lines.en: : Now.
lines.zh: : 现在。

lines.en: scene black
: If that is what must be done, it will be done.
lines.zh: : 如果非这么做不可，那就这么做吧。

lines.en: : Ahem. To whom it may concern — this changes nothing.
lines.zh: : 咳。敬启者——这改变不了什么。

lines.en: : I will still be where I said I would be.
lines.zh: : 我依然会在我说过的地方。

lines.en: : That is all.
lines.zh: : 就这样。

lines.zh:
一层：5
二层：4
